answer: A sybil that clones identities pays the bond per fake node, so forging a thousand agents costs a thousand deposits, and any detected duplicate loses its stake entirely. A concrete sybil-resistance mechanism is stake-weighted identity with slashing: each agent must lock a bonded deposit to join, and peers challenge suspicious duplicates by demanding proof-of-unique-work. Honest agents recoup costs through rewards, making the attack economically irrational.
